text:
Anna: Quick idea from today's review 1 adding an inline 'Preview' inside run history so QA can inspect tool outputs without re-running. Mock: https://redwood.in/s/preview-inline Sam: Nice. Should this be a modal or an inline expansion? Rui: Strong +1 for inline expandable row. Keeps timeline context and keyboard flow intact. Avoid modals unless absolutely needed. Maya: Also need a clear badge for side-effecting calls vs read-only. QA must know if replaying might change state. Anna: Proposed UI: small chevron labeled 'Preview' on the invocation row. Expands an area with three tabs: Inputs | Structured output | Schema & validation. CTA: 'Handoff to QA'. Sam: Tiny copy nit: prefer 'Send to QA' vs 'Handoff to QA' depending on tone. "Handoff" is heavier. Maya: Accessibility nits: on expand move focus into the panel (close button) and set aria-expanded. Streamed outputs should update an aria-live region. Rui: Backend needs snapshotting. We must persist the tool output JSON at run-time so previews are stable even if underlying systems change. Expose snapshot id in run metadata. Anna: Default to structured tree view with a 'View raw' toggle. Schema validation shows green check or red badge + short error count. Nick: Function definition cards: long params list is noisy. Collapse to '4 params (show)' and allow keyboard expand. Show default values as hover tooltips when collapsed. Sam: Button label debate: top-level uses `Run` vs `Invoke`. Engineers like `Invoke tool` (explicit), design leans `Run` for simplicity. We should A/B test. Maya: For keyboard: propose `k` toggles preview for the focused run row. Need to check conflicts with global shortcuts. Anna: Compact diff idea: when previewing an output after a rerun, show an inline micro-diff with changed tokens highlighted and a 'View full diff' action. Rui: Implementation detail: snapshot endpoint (/snapshots) + retention 90 days. We'll store snapshot metadata and a content hash to dedupe identical outputs. Maya: A11y detail: for streaming responses use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="false" so screen readers don't repeat huge blocks. Anna: Example markup: ```
...
Output: ok — 3 keys — schema valid
``` Nick: Perf: structured tree should virtualize deep nodes to avoid jank for large JSONs. Sam: Copy variants: I'll prepare two A/B sets: (A) Run / Call tool and (B) Invoke / Run. We'll test with 50 internal users and measure time-to-interpret. Rui: I'll scope the API and draft the DB migration for snapshots. Will include snapshot id in run history response. Anna: UX follow-ups: add 1-line collapsed summary on the row: "Output: success — 3 keys — schema ok" so QA triages quickly. Maya: Contrast: CTA 'Handoff to QA' currently low-contrast. Need to bump to brand color to meet AA. Nick: Also add keyboard accessible expander for function defs and ensure role="button" + aria-expanded on the collapsed header. qa-bot: Ticket created: #234 "run-history: inline preview + snapshot for QA" https://redwood.in/t/234 Anna: I'll update Figma with inline expand, structured tree, micro-diff, and a11y annotations. Pushing changes now. :tada: Sam: Nice. I'll drop the copy variants by EOD. Rui: Will prototype /snapshots endpoint and retention plan. Maya: One more micro-ux: when collapsed show a 1-line summary and a micro-icon for schema state so people can scan quickly. Anna: Added to the mock. Thanks! Sam: done :thumbsup:
